verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm, but it offers productized legal workflows through its Clerky partnership, so a public API is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no documented public API: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The llms.txt file is only a descriptive overview of the firm, not a programmatic interface, and the Clerky workflows are described only as a platform for founders to use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
